source: Textured Clash-Royale-style Meshy AI model supplied by the product owner (GitHub release, stored as .cache/meshy2/bonez_src.glb). Mesh and texture content unchanged; game copy reduced by tools/meshy/reduce.py (120k triangles, base colour 4096, maps 2048) and rigged by tools/meshy/skin.py
license: Depends on the product owner's Meshy plan: free-plan generations are CC BY 4.0 (credit Meshy), paid plans grant ownership - verify before release
likeness: Depicts a real person at the product owner's request; name/likeness rights must be cleared before release
trademark_note: The generated tracksuit carries a green crocodile emblem; check before release that it cannot be confused with a registered mark
